items.name: dot-grid
items.title: Dot Grid
items.description: A background grid of dots that pushes away from the cursor and springs back.

items.name: gooey-dots
items.title: Gooey Dots
items.description: Drifting dots that merge into one liquid shape when they come close.

items.name: dot-matrix-text
items.title: Dot Matrix Text
items.description: Text rendered as a dot matrix that assembles from scattered dots as it scrolls into view.

items.name: grain-gradient
items.title: Grain Gradient
items.description: A WebGL surface with a curved, diffused edge between three colors, film grain and a slow breathing motion.

items.name: dithered-logo
items.title: Dithered Logo
items.description: Any image or SVG turned into a dithered particle field that repels the cursor and ripples on click.

items.name: ascii-effect
items.title: ASCII Effect
items.description: An image or video rendered as live ASCII characters with flow, glitch and cursor ripple modes.

items.name: wheel-carousel
items.title: Wheel Carousel
items.description: A rotating wheel of labels on a curve with a photo that crossfades to the active item.

items.name: scroll-surf
items.title: Scroll Surf
items.description: A scroll-driven gallery where tilted cards surf toward the viewer along a perspective track.

items.name: expand-on-hover
items.title: Expand on Hover
items.description: A row of tall pill-shaped image strips where the hovered strip widens and the rest shrink.

items.name: expand-on-hover-vertical
items.title: Expand on Hover Vertical
items.description: A stack of pill-shaped image rows where the hovered row grows tall and the rest flatten.

items.name: spine-gallery
items.title: Spine Gallery
items.description: Thin ruled columns with vertical names that open wide on hover to reveal a photo and a year.

items.name: scene-reveal
items.title: Scene Reveal
items.description: A scroll-driven hand-off where the hero pushes in and the next scene breaks through a growing window.

items.name: image-reveal
items.title: Image Reveal
items.description: A sticky stage where each image wipes up from the bottom as you scroll, then settles back.

items.name: devouring-sign-in
items.title: Devouring Sign In
items.description: A large email field whose text is eaten into dust from the right when you submit.

items.name: gooey-effect
items.title: Gooey Effect
items.description: Draggable shapes that melt into each other when they touch. Wrap any elements in GooeyEffect.Item; the wrapper and its parent must have no background colour so the filter only sees the shapes.

items.name: vector-wordmark
items.title: Vector Wordmark
items.description: A heavy wordmark that turns into a dotted vector outline with editor handles and coordinates around the cursor.

items.name: circular-gallery
items.title: Circular Gallery
items.description: A ring of tangential image cards that the wheel flies into and spins endlessly, with cards flipping, swelling and pushing out toward the cursor at rest.

items.name: lens-carousel
items.title: Lens Carousel
items.description: A looping row of photo cards whose edges pass under two slabs of bending glass with colour fringing.

items.name: film-grain
items.title: Film Grain
items.description: An animated film grain overlay for any section, drawn on the GPU and blended with what sits beneath it.

items.name: window-transition
items.title: Window Transition
items.description: A page transition that reveals the next page through a small rounded window growing to fill the viewport while the old page dims behind it.

items.name: orbit-tiles
items.title: Orbit Tiles
items.description: Tiles drifting along a tilted elliptical orbit in perspective, sharp and large in front, soft and small behind, draggable to spin.

items.name: dot-globe
items.title: Dot Globe
items.description: A dotted globe drawn on canvas with approximate continents, auto rotation, drag with inertia and hoverable markers.

items.name: liquid-smoke
items.title: Liquid Smoke
items.description: Slow plumes of smoke rising from the bottom of a section, drawn with warped noise on the GPU.

items.name: goo-carve-button
items.title: Goo Carve Button
items.description: A pill button where a liquid blob carves into the surface on hover, chases the cursor, stretches into a teardrop with speed and reveals the blob colour underneath.

items.name: ink-bleed
items.title: Ink Bleed
items.description: Heavy text under a gooey filter where a drop of ink trails the cursor and melts into whichever letter it touches.

items.name: dust-transition
items.title: Dust Transition
items.description: A scroll-driven hand-off where the hero dollies in, a flare bursts at the focus and the next scene eats through it as glowing dust.

items.name: pill-nav
items.title: Pill Nav
items.description: A floating pill navigation bar that unfolds into a full-height menu and opens a command search.

items.name: dynamic-island
items.title: Dynamic Island
items.description: A black pill that springs between a compact idle shape and richer live activity states.

items.name: image-wheel-3d
items.title: Image Wheel 3D
items.description: A tilted ring of image cards standing on edge like a rolodex, seen from above in perspective. The wheel turns with the mouse wheel or spins on its own, cards lift on hover and the camera leans toward the cursor.

items.name: morphing-text
items.title: Morphing Text
items.description: Words that melt into one another: each fades through a blur while an alpha threshold turns the overlap into gooey bridges.

items.name: text-tunnel
items.title: Text Tunnel
items.description: Rows of text scroll through a WebGL tunnel that folds and stretches them toward the edges, with bloom and a spectral fringe.

items.name: split-word-loader
items.title: Split Word Loader
items.description: A page loader whose word rises letter by letter, splits open around a window of cycling images, then grows the last image into the page.

items.name: dot-canvas
items.title: Dot Canvas
items.description: Canvas 2D hook that sizes for high-DPI, pauses offscreen, and tracks the pointer.
